sources.summary: Mount Martha House is a cost-effective timber family home inspired by the vernacular of the Mornington Peninsula; a contemporary interpretation of Australian coastal architecture. Its L-shaped layout embraces an established pin oak tree, creating a private outdoor space with a pool and deck that integrates with the natural surroundings.
